🔥 video-shotcraft | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate cinematic product videos using AI, leveraging Claude Code or Codex and the Remotion framework.
✨ Key Features: • AI agent skill for Claude Code & Codex • Creates cinematic product videos • Uses Remotion for animation and production • Includes 152 shot recipe cards and 209 motion previews
📖 Summary: video-shotcraft is an AI agent skill that transforms Claude Code or Codex into a motion design studio, enabling the creation of cinematic product videos. It uses Remotion to storyboard, animate, and sound-design promotional, marketing, or demo videos with features like real page captures, 2.5D camera moves, and beat-synced cuts.
